summary: Completed testing of new referral code + ID card upload features. Backend APIs working correctly. Frontend registration flow working with one bug fixed (payment fee display). Committee cards correctly hide Chair/EB/Difficulty. Admin dashboard displays uploaded ID cards.

fixed_bugs.issue: Payment screen showed hardcoded ₹2000 instead of dynamic fee based on referral code
fixed_bugs.fix: Added calculateFee() function to compute fee dynamically (₹1500 with referral, ₹2000 without)

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/registrations accepts id_card field (base64 string)
Backend: GET /api/admin/registrations returns id_card in response
Backend: Referral code PARAMOUNT500 applies ₹500 discount (fee = ₹1500)
Frontend: ID upload field NOT visible initially on step 6
Frontend: Entering referral code PARAMOUNT500 shows warning note
Frontend: ID upload field appears after entering referral code
Frontend: Validation error when trying to proceed without ID upload
Frontend: ID card preview shown after upload
Frontend: Payment screen shows ₹1500 with referral code (after fix)
Frontend: Payment screen shows ₹2000 without referral code
Frontend: Committee cards do NOT show Chair/Executive Board/Difficulty
Frontend: Committee cards show Agenda, Live seats, Handbook and Register buttons
Admin: ID card section present in registration drawer
Admin: Uploaded ID card (base64 image) displayed with data-testid='admin-id-card'
Admin: Registrations without referral show 'No ID uploaded' message
